remarks: Nestled in a beautiful 10 acre park like setting, this updated unit is sun-filled. From its top floor location enjoy the balcony overlooking a the treetops. Totally renovated kitchen and bathroom in 2018, you can just move right in. Hardwood floors and new carpet fill the living room, dining room and bedroom. Laundry in bldg. Intercom system in unit. Garage parking potentially available for $85.00 month. Walk to Greenwich Ave, Whole Foods and train.
